Isotope Sampling with the CoWS by Picarro
====================

 - Constant water stream from reservoir
 - Standards
 - Time critical process
 
## Maintanance

 - Check standards - how much is left?
 - Take standard sample in 2ml vial
 - clean Reflow Pressure Stop (RPS) if necessary
 - check drierite column in CoWS, replacement needed?
 
## How to refill standard

 - Close the valve of the standard bag
 - Disconnect the standard bag from the CoWS (the Festo fitting remains at the bag)
 - Fig 1: Take out the standard bag, and connect the peristaltic pump. Use a 4mm tube to connect with the water to fill in, not 6mm. The water source should be placed higher up than the pump.
 - Fig 2: When the bag is full enough, lift the side with the valve and press the air out 
 - Place the standard back into the rack (closing the valve is a good option) and put something under the left side to lift it.
 - Reconnect the standard back with the CoWS
